title: Learn basic cinematography and explicitly describe camera position and camera…
content:
Learn basic cinematography and explicitly describe camera position and camera movement in your Seedance prompts.

Treat each Seedance prompt like a mini script by specifying scene layout, cinematography, and sound design to reduce generic outputs.

Redo and regenerate scenes multiple times in Seedance (even if it burns credits) until the output meets your quality bar.
